review: 504.1-1: the does_not_fire variant changed two facts (active player, and whom B's Necropotence already in the base skips); removed Necropotence from the base, added variant b_active (B draws) and made draw_step_skipped put Necropotence on A's side

scenarios.title: The active player draws a card at the start of the draw step

setup.notes: A's library has Island on top and B's has Forest on top. Both hands are empty.

decisions: The draw step begins and the active player draws as a turn-based action; players then receive priority and pass.

variants.label: active_draws
variants.expected: A draws Island (hand 1 card, library 1 card). B draws nothing (hand 0, library 2 cards).

variants.label: b_active
variants.delta: The active player is B, so the draw step is B's.
variants.expected: B draws Forest (hand 1 card, library 1 card). A draws nothing (hand 0, library 2 cards).

operation.unclassifiable: phase or turn: B is the active player instead of A

variants.label: draw_step_skipped
variants.expected: A's draw step is skipped, so A draws nothing (hand 0, library 2 cards, Island still on top); B draws nothing either.

operation.unclassifiable: phase or turn: Necropotence must be on the battlefield before A's draw step begins, but the base board is already in the draw step

scenarios.forge_notes: Necropotence ('Skip your draw step') is a BeginPhase replacement with Skip$ True; in variant draw_step_skipped it is on A's battlefield.

detector.outcome: At the start of the draw step the active player draws as a turn-based action: the turn_action record holds a card_drawn event.
detector.near_miss: No near miss is declared: a skipped draw step leaves no record.
